human_review.text: A person must review the findings and decide whether the remedies are acceptable.

limitations: This is a research data-readiness screen. It is not a clinical tool and makes no claim of clinical validity, regulatory compliance, or production readiness.
Identifier detection is heuristic. A pass does not guarantee that no personal information is present.
Leakage detection checks one feature at a time and can miss leakage spread across several features.
Thresholds (events per parameter, minimum subgroup size, missingness) are configurable defaults, not clinical standards.
Subgroup coverage uses minimum counts and does not compare against a reference population.

findings.reason: Field 'tumor_size' is missing for 27% of the cohort.
findings.remedy: Plan and document an imputation strategy, or drop the field.
findings.reconsider: A documented imputation plan, or the result with and without that field.
findings.effect_on_intended_use: Missing values shrink the group that can be analysed and can bias it. Usable for this question only after the next step is taken and reported.
findings.evidence_or_source: Measured max_feature_missing_rate = 0.271. Rule CMP-004 (max_feature_missing_rate > 0.2 and max_feature_missing_rate <= 0.5 -> CONDITIONAL), policy v0.5.1, on synthea_breast_cohort.
findings.limitation: Counts missing values; it can't tell why they are missing.

findings.reason: Some subgroups are too small to evaluate model behavior reliably: race=hawaiian (n=13), race=other (n=13), race=native (n=2).
findings.remedy: Report subgroup performance with uncertainty, or obtain more data for these groups.
findings.reconsider: More records for those groups, or results reported with uncertainty.
findings.uncertainty: Exact count; no sampling uncertainty applies to this check.
findings.effect_on_intended_use: With few patients in a group, the model's behaviour in that group can't be judged. Usable for this question only after the next step is taken and reported.
findings.evidence_or_source: Measured n_small_subgroups = 3. Rule SUB-002 (n_small_subgroups > 0 -> CONDITIONAL), policy v0.5.1, on synthea_breast_cohort.
findings.limitation: Minimum counts only; no comparison with a reference population.
